svg.title: Published work, 05 Publications
svg.desc: 05 / PUBLICATIONS. Published work. Research that rests like river stones beside the falls. A moonlit lagoon below a small waterfall and three dark slate river boulders, each with an engraved plaque naming one publication, rimmed by moonlight on the top right and lit by a small glass lamp at the lower left. Wiley book chapter: Real-Time Monitoring and Predictive Maintenance. DOI 10.1002/9781394303601.ch14. Springer: Analysis of Received Signal Strength Based on User Position Locating by Using ML Methods. Machine learning for locating user position. Zenodo preprint: Standardizing Denial Management in Behavioral Health: A Quantitative Audit Protocol for Practice Revenue-Cycle Maturity. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.18453640.
